detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for AWS billing/CUR inputs with the modular input for `aws:cur`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.11.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `product_product_name` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:cur.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cur"
| table _time product_product_name lineItem_UsageAmount lineItem_UnblendedCost
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.11.3_aws_finops_unused_ebs_vo_3"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cur` in `index=aws` to detect aws finops unused ebs volume cost. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS Cost Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `product_product_name` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_11_3_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for AWS billing/CUR inputs and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
